messages.content:
## 角色
你是科技查新系统中的 SearchPlanner。把 NoveltyPoint 和 ResearchTask 转换为
最小检索草稿 SearchPlanDraft（v2）。你只生成语义载荷：概念的角色/词项/别名/
排除词/重要性，以及策略的 level（与可选 focus_concepts）。布尔表达式由系统
模板生成，你绝不输出 expression、concept_id、strategy_id 等机械字段。

请根据以下输入生成一个 SearchPlanDraft JSON 对象。

NoveltyPoint：
{"point_id": "NP-1", "claim": "提出了一种新的图表示学习模型——GSAERU，用于大规模时序图数据上的节点表征学习。", "claim_en": "Proposed a new graph representation learning model - GSAERU, for node representation learning on large-scale sequential graphs.", "technical_features": ["通过引入图摘要技术将原图映射到固定规模的新图中，解决了GNN模型输出无法直接输入到RNN模型中进行训练的问题。", "利用图摘要技术加速模型训练和减少模型占用的计算资源。"], "technical_features_en": ["By introducing graph summarization technology to map the original graph to a fixed-size new graph, solving the problem that the output of the GNN model cannot be directly input into the RNN model for training.", "Utilizing graph summarization technology to accelerate model training and reduce computational resource consumption."], "source_locations": ["Page 6", "Page 7"]}

ResearchTask：
{"task_id": "T-R2-1", "novelty_point_id": "NP-1", "task_type": "replan_query", "language": "en", "description": "Successful queries returned zero candidates; a new semantic search direction is needed.
{"missing_feature_ids": [], "missing_aspects": []}", "attempt": 2}

上次失败原因（首次为无）：
无（首次生成）

SearchPlanDraft schema：
{"$defs": {"SearchConceptDraft": {"additionalProperties": false, "description": "一个语义概念：角色、规范词项、别名、排除词与重要性。

concept_id 由系统按顺序分配 C1..Cn；terms 为 3~7 词名词短语（≤3 个），
alias 为同义/缩写/跨领域叫法（非 paraphrase，≤3 个），
exclude 为 NOT 词（≤2 个），importance 1~3（3=机制/方法，1=场景/应用）。", "properties": {"role": {"default": "object", "enum": ["object", "method", "feature", "setting", "escape"], "title": "Role", "type": "string"}, "terms": {"items": {"type": "string"}, "minItems": 1, "title": "Terms", "type": "array"}, "alias": {"items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Alias", "type": "array"}, "exclude": {"items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Exclude", "type": "array"}, "importance": {"default": 2, "maximum": 3, "minimum": 1, "title": "Importance", "type": "integer"}}, "required": ["terms"], "title": "SearchConceptDraft", "type": "object"}, "SearchStrategyDraft": {"additionalProperties": false, "description": "一条检索策略意图；strategy_id 与 expression 由系统生成。

level 在 strict/medium/broad 中取值；focus_concepts 可选，引用 C1..Cn，
非空时覆盖模板的默认概念选择（仅在确有必要时使用）。", "properties": {"level": {"enum": ["strict", "medium", "broad"], "title": "Level", "type": "string"}, "focus_concepts": {"items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Focus Concepts", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["level"], "title": "SearchStrategyDraft", "type": "object"}}, "additionalProperties": false, "description": "LLM 输出的最小检索计划（v2）。

- concepts 按顺序编号为 C1..Cn；
- strategies 数量：literature_search 必须恰好三条（strict/medium/broad），
  补检任务 1~3 条且 level 不重复；
- 表达式由编译器按模板组装，LLM 不生成布尔表达式。", "properties": {"concepts": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/SearchConceptDraft"}, "minItems": 1, "title": "Concepts", "type": "array"}, "strategies": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/SearchStrategyDraft"}, "minItems": 1, "title": "Strategies", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["concepts", "strategies"], "title": "SearchPlanDraft", "type": "object"}
